about: Transform copies the target's ability (Pokemon Central, Trasformazione). A level-10 Pikachu given Levitate (set:) and Splash and Mud-Slap (teach:) faces a forced wild Ditto that knows only Transform: the Ditto becomes a Pikachu with Levitate, and the Mud-Slap, a Ground move that would be super effective on an Electric type, does not touch it ("The wild Ditto makes Ground moves miss by using Levitate!"). Before, the ability had been widened out of the forty bytes BtlCmd_Transform copies, so the Ditto kept its own and took the hit ("It's super effective!" and its accuracy fell). The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Ditto transformed into Pikachu!

new_lines: The wild Ditto makes Ground moves miss by using Levitate!
